description: This source file implements the BufferParser class and its derived classes (AudioBufferParser and VideoBufferParser) for parsing media buffers in a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It includes functions for extracting media segment data, handling protection metadata, and adding codec data to media segments.

classes.name: BufferParser
classes.description: Base class for parsing media buffers, providing methods to parse buffer data, add protection metadata, and add codec data.

classes.name: AudioBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing audio-specific buffer data, extracting sample rate and channel count.

classes.name: VideoBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing video-specific buffer data, extracting width, height, and framerate.

methods.name: parseBuffer
methods.description: Main method to parse a media buffer and produce a MediaSegment object.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadataToSegment
methods.description: Adds encryption and protection metadata to a media segment based on buffer and structure info.

methods.name: addCodecDataToSegment
methods.description: Extracts codec data from structure and adds it to the media segment.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer
methods.description: Virtual method overridden in derived classes to parse specific media data (audio/video) from buffer structures.
